title: LoL Esports Community Competition Guidelines
summary: LoL Esports Community Competition Guidelines  LoL Esports
content:
We're making it easier than ever to organize League of Legends community competitions. Our updated global guidelines remove outdated restrictions, streamline licensing into a single community competition framework, and reduce restrictions on entry fees, sponsorships, prize pools, and spectator fees. In most cases, organizers will no longer need to wait for Riot approval to run an event. Follow the guidelines, submit your competition through ourvisibility form(pw: riotevent), and start building for your community.

Whether you're organizing a local LAN, a college tournament, or an online bracket, these guidelines are designed to support community competition across the evolving League of Legends experience, including Summoner's Rift, ARAM, Arena, League of Legends Classic, and future experiences.

You're free to organize League of Legends competitions at nearly any scale, whether that's a local LAN at your PC café, a school or university, an online community competition, an open bracket, or a larger invitational event. We want to support community competition across League's growing ecosystem of game modes, including Summoner's Rift, Arena, League Classic, and future experiences.

These guidelines are designed for community organizers operating independently and in good faith. However, some organizations are not covered under this community competition license and will need to work directly with Riot through a separate process.

We know community competitions take time, effort, and resources to run, and we want organizers to have the flexibility to build sustainable events. There are no fixed caps on entry fees, sponsorship revenue, prize pools, or spectator ticketing under these guidelines.

We do ask organizers to act reasonably, provide fair value to players, fans, and partners participating in the event, and avoid misleading or deceptive practices. While we have removed many of the previous restrictions, certain sponsor categories remain off-limits. You can find the full list of restricted sponsors below in the “What types of sponsors should I avoid making agreements with?” section.

title: LoL Esports
content:
The competitive League of Legends ecosystem is buzzing following the latest announcement regarding 'LoL Esports'. As the season progresses, this development has quickly taken center stage, drawing intense scrutiny from fans, analysts, and professional players alike. Riot Games continues to refine the competitive structure, balancing the game's high skill ceiling with spectator entertainment. The professional scene is an ever-evolving battleground where even the smallest adjustment can make or break a team's championship aspirations. Every coach, analyst, and player must stay ahead of the curve to remain competitive.

Speaking on the recent events, seasoned esports analysts noted that 'LoL Esports  LoL Esports' is not just a temporary trend but a fundamental shift in how teams will approach their upcoming matchdays. As the community awaits the upcoming weekend matches, anticipation continues to build. title: Esports Charts Nominated for Esports Supporting Service of the Year
summary: Esports Charts Nominated for Esports Supporting Service of the Year  Esports Charts
content:
LIVE Viewership Updates & Audience Trends

Esports Charts, the leading esports analytics platform, has been nominated for "Esports Supporting Service of the Year" at the Esports Awards 2026. The category recognizes companies that provide essential services helping organizations, tournaments, teams, and other stakeholders succeed across the esports industry.

The Esports Awards is one of the industry's most prestigious annual events, celebrating excellence across competitive gaming. Following last year's nomination forEsports Supporting Platform of the Year, Esports Charts has once again been recognized, this time in the newly introducedEsports Supporting Service of the Yearcategory.

"Our mission hasn't changed since day one: to make esports data easier to access, understand, and act on,"said Artyom Odintsov, CEO & Co-founder of Esports Charts. "Whether it's making industry-leading metrics like Media Value publicly available for tournaments, creating a dedicated Viewership Hub for the Esports World Cup, or launching the Global Esports Map, every initiative we build is driven by the same goal — to give everyone in the esports ecosystem better tools to understand audiences, measure impact, and make informed decisions. We're honored to see that long-term commitment recognized by the Esports Awards."

Fans and industry professionals can cast their votes daily for the Esports Awards 2026 through the official voting page. Voting is now open and will remain available untilNovember 10th, 2026, with the winners to be announced during the Esports Awards ceremony held in Miami, USA, later this year.

Esports Charts has been recognized by the Esports Awards on multiple occasions. The company wonEsports Coverage Platform of the Yearin 2023, was nominated in the same category in 2024, earned a nomination forEsports Coverage Platform of the Decadein 2025, was shortlisted forEsports Supporting Platform of the Yearthat same year, and now joins the nominees forEsports Supporting Service of the Yearin 2026.
